svg.text: drawn by edakit schematic draw – change the graph, not this drawing
JST_2PIN in the schematic: pin 1 GND, pin 2 VBAT; the package's two
solder tabs NC1, NC2 are on no net. Typed battery_holder so that a
cell state of sim.json sits on it.
USB_C in the schematic (CUI CUSB31-CFM2AX-01-X, pads A1B12, B1A12,
A4B9, B4A9 paired): SBU1 and SBU2 open; the shell's four legs M1–M4
have no pin in the symbol and no net on the board – open as published.
IREG = 1000 V / RPROG: R3 10 kΩ alone 100 mA, R3 with R4 through SJ1
HEADER-1X5 in the schematic, a row of 70-mil pads (0.1" breakout
pads); a 1 × 5 header stands in, not fitted.
